NOTE (Wed 22 Jul) — Burnham reset with the devolved nations:
- Scottish Labour leader Anas Sarwar to stand down, take a peerage and become a minister (expected: Dept for Business, Innovation, Science & Trade under Jonathan Reynolds).
- Welsh First Minister Rhun ap Iorwerth (Plaid): Burnham is "open to listening perhaps in a way that Keir Starmer wasn't" on Welsh devolution (wants policing, rail, funding devolved); spoke to Burnham Tue, both want a "constructive" relationship.
- Scotland's FM John Swinney (SNP): Burnham reassured him he wants a "collaborative" relationship; says UK-Scottish relations "soured significantly" when Douglas Alexander became Scottish Secretary (Sept 2025); takes Burnham's words at "face value". (Alexander kept his post in the reshuffle.)
- Junior-minister slate confirmed Tue night: Dan Jarvis (Security Minister, Home Office/Cabinet Office), James Murray (Financial Secretary to the Treasury & Paymaster General), Lucy Rigby (Economic Secretary), Anna Turley (Home Office), Florence Eshalomi (housing), Andy Slaughter (Solicitor General); 17 re-appointments incl Sarah Sackman, Luke Pollard. [Ref: gov.uk / LabourList]
